class.name: Light3D
class.brief_description: Base class for lights in a 3D scene.
class.description: Provides light color and intensity settings. Other light types add range or direction settings.

method.name: SetIntensity
method.description: Sets the light intensity value and updates the render light. Does not clamp the value.
method.param: The light strength. Use a non-negative value; zero gives no light.

method.name: SetColor
method.description: Sets the light color and updates the render light.
method.param: The light color. Color channels use the engine Color type.
